description: Use this when the person names a border crossing, a town at a border, two countries or an airport and you need its id. Not for crossings around a place: use list_border_crossings_near. Answers border crossings and airports' passport control whose names, towns or countries match the words in any order, any language Borders knows, plurals, case or a typo: each with its id, its names, the two countries or the airport's city, and its link on borders.me; the closest names when nothing matches; at most 50.
name: search_border_crossings
title: Search border crossings
